notes.title: Update v1.0.2
notes.content:
We are proud to announce the latest update v1.0.2!
This update focuses mainly on player feedback.
You can read the patch notes [url=http://www.fatcatgames.com/huckleberryfalls/patchnotes.htm]here[/url].

notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce the first update since release: v1.0.1
This update fixes several performance hindering issues.
It also fixes several issues players encountered while running the game.
Thanks everyone for your feedback.

[url=http://www.fatcatgames.com/huckleberryfalls/patchnotes.htm] Patch Notes[/url]
